name: library-rust
description: Rust implementation probes using the actual public library modules copied unchanged from src.

cases.reason: Actual public Sub and UniqueArray modules execute generic shared boundaries and containers of native owners.
The unchanged Aff.Do runtime test imports the actual public Aff, Aff.Unsafe and Aff.Do modules.
The native Owner's public library instance grants Drop but not Clone.
A container does not grant Clone when its element lacks that capability.
The actual runShared boundary prevents a non-shared native owner from escaping.
